subject: Compliance acceptance sprint: scope & deliverables
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Kozlov <ekozlov@clearwise.com>, security@clearwise.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance acceptance sprint: scope & deliverables

Hi Elena / Clearwise team,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and clear alignment on the goals. I wanted to capture the key pain points, acceptance criteria, and next steps so we can move to a short evidence sprint. High-level recap below, then proposed owners and dates.

Pain / goals we heard
- Audit log retention: you need immutable audit logs for transaction traces and a 5-year retention baseline with the ability to export on demand.
- SOC 2 scope: your compliance gate requires Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report covering production inference and logging pipeline.
- DPA & legal: you have a few contract redlines around data residency and subprocessor disclosure.
- Pen test: you need a summary of Redwood’s most recent third-party penetration test and confirmation of remediation status.

Acceptance criteria (what Clearwise needs to sign off on)
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK) and a one-page summary mapping scope to your controls.
2) Audit log sample (redacted) in NDJSON or CSV showing fields you asked for (timestamp, request_id, masked_payload, user_id, model_version).
3) Retention matrix that maps hot/cold retention windows and export procedure.
4) Redlines on the DPA and a proposed timeline for finalization.
5) Pen-test summary + remediation status.

Proposed deliverables & owners
- retention_matrix.xlsx (Tessa) — draft to you by 2026-11-27
- soc2_type2_summary.pdf (Ben) — provide redacted copy by 2026-11-25
- pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf (Ben) — provide by 2026-11-25
- dpa_redlines_v1.docx (Marissa) — upload with comments by 2026-11-24
- audit_log_sample.ndjson (Tessa) — share pre-signed S3 link once we agree access method (target 2026-11-29)

Immediate asks for Clearwise
- Confirm acceptance criteria above (particularly log fields and retention window).
- Share preferred method for receiving the audit sample (S3 pre-signed, secure SharePoint, or encrypted SFTP).
- Confirm who from InfoSec/legal will review the DPA (name + email) so we can loop them into the Doc/Drive folder.

I’ve attached a retention matrix template and an initial DPA redlines doc to get us started. If that all looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute working session for Monday 2026-11-23 10:00 PT to go through the matrix and hand off the artifact channels.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0199
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), dpa_redlines_v1.docx (word)

From: Elena Kozlov <ekozlov@clearwise.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearwise.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Compliance acceptance sprint: scope & deliverables

Thanks Tessa — this is helpful and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from InfoSec: 

- Retention window: we intend to require 5 years of immutable audit logs for any transaction-level records. Is that feasible with Redwood’s retention tiers (hot vs cold)?
- Log schema: Can the sample include a mapping file that explains each field (we saw your requested fields; we need to confirm masking rules for PII).
- Pen test vendor: our security team will want vendor name and scope (we use Pentagard as our external assessor and will compare scopes).
- DPA review: Legal will do the redline pass; please route the Doc to legal@clearwise.com and cc security@clearwise.com.

We’re comfortable with redacted SOC2 but will want a mapping doc that ties your controls to our control matrix.

We can accept a pre-signed S3 link for the sample logs (preferred) — we’ll provide a short whitelist IP range if needed. I’ll confirm the reviewer list (InfoSec + Legal) by end-of-day tomorrow.

Elena
Elena Kozlov
Director of Product & Compliance, Clearwise Payments
elena.kozl@clearwise.com

Attachment: clearwise_asset_inventory.csv (coming separately)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Kozlov <ekozlov@clearwise.com>, security@clearwise.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance acceptance sprint: scope & deliverables

Elena — quick answers and a trimmed deliverable plan from our side. Thanks for the questions.

Feasibility and details
- 5-year retention: yes — Redwood supports configurable retention. Typical pattern is 30 days hot (fast access) + configurable cold archive up to 7 years. We’ll document export/restore SLA in the retention matrix.
- Log schema & masking: we will provide an audit_log_sample.ndjson with masked PII and a mapping file (field_definitions.csv). The sample will include the fields you requested and an explanation of masking rules.
- SOC 2: we’ll share a redacted Type II report and a one-page control mapping (soc2_type2_summary.pdf).
- Pen test: vendor: Pentagard, scope: production-facing inference endpoints + auth and telemetry ingestion. We’ll provide a redacted summary (pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf) and a remediation status table.

Deliverables (owners & committed dates)
- soc2_type2_summary.pdf — Ben — 2026-11-25
- pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf — Ben — 2026-11-25
- retention_matrix.xlsx (draft) — Tessa — 2026-11-27
- dpa_redlines_v1.docx — Marissa — 2026-11-24
- audit_log_sample.ndjson (pre-signed S3 link) — Tessa — 2026-11-29

Security note: the audit sample will be redacted and only include synthesized customer identifiers or hashed/partial IDs. We’ll share a pre-signed S3 link with expiration and require a short access acknowledgment from your InfoSec team.

Next steps
1) Tessa will schedule the working session Monday 11/23 10:00 PT (calendar invite inbound).
2) Elena: please confirm legal@clearwise.com and the InfoSec reviewer contact.
3) Ben/Marissa: we’ll upload the SOC2 and pen-test summaries to the shared Drive folder once redactions are complete.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments (uploaded to Drive): soc2_type2_summary.pdf, pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf, field_definitions.csv

From: Elena Kozlov <ekozlov@clearwise.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearwise.com, legal@clearwise.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Compliance acceptance sprint: scope & deliverables

Thanks Ben/Tessa — that timeline works for us. Confirming:
- Working session Monday 2026-11-23 at 10:00 PT (we’ll accept the calendar invite).
- Legal reviewer: legal@clearwise.com (in this thread).
- InfoSec reviewer: security@clearwise.com (in this thread).

We’ll look for the SOC2 and pen-test summaries on Drive and the retention matrix on Monday morning. Please send the pre-signed S3 link for the audit sample once the Drive uploads are in place.

Appreciate the clear owners/dates — let’s use the Drive folder you created for iterations:
https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/clearevidence-CLW-2026

Elena

Note: we’ll provide IP whitelisting for the pre-signed link; please confirm expiry window when you send it.
